# Journal of Economic Perspectives — LLM-Friendly Companion Files

> Static site hosting machine-readable (Markdown + JSON) companion files for articles published in the *Journal of Economic Perspectives* (American Economic Association, ISSN 0895-3309). Maintained at the repository `liegroup-dartmouth/working-aea-jep`, served from the `gh-pages` branch.

> Note for AI agents: The structured article index lists every article with its title, authors, miniabstract, DOI, article type, symposium, and URLs for the full-text Markdown, abstracts, figures, and data files. It is approximately 28 KB and fits within a single response.

**GitHub Pages URL** (use if reachable):
```
https://liegroup-dartmouth.github.io/working-aea-jep/papers/article-index.json
```

**GitHub raw URL** (recommended, reachable from most agent network environments):
```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liegroup-dartmouth/working-aea-jep/refs/heads/gh-pages/papers/article-index.json
```

Fetch the article index first. Use the `title`, `miniabstract`, and `symposium_name` fields to identify relevant articles before fetching any full text. See [AI Access]({{ site.baseurl }}/ai-access.html) for more detail on what agents can and cannot retrieve through this channel.

## Primary entry points

- [papers/article-index.json](https://liegroup-dartmouth.github.io/working-aea-jep/papers/article-index.json): structured JSON catalog of every issue and article — title, authors, pages, DOI, mini-abstract, and URLs for the abstract, full-text Markdown, figures, and associated data files. Use this for programmatic ingestion.
- [papers/index.md](https://liegroup-dartmouth.github.io/working-aea-jep/papers/index.md): human-readable Markdown catalog of the same content. Useful when a model prefers prose to JSON.

## Per-article content

For every article the article index lists:

- `abstract.html` — short abstract.
- `paper.md` — full article text (title, authors, abstract, all sections, footnotes, figure captions). Fetch this URL for the article body.
- `image/*.jpg` — figure image files. Image **bytes** cannot be fetched from most agent environments; figure captions inside the `paper.md` carry the interpretive content (axes, units, principal finding) so a text-only agent can understand each figure without seeing it.
- `image-data/*.csv` — underlying data tables for figures (where provided). URLs render the CSV inline and are cleanly extractable.

## Repository path structure

All paper files are nested under a `papers/` directory. For example, the Starr article on noncompete clauses is at:
```
papers/v40n1/starr/paper.md
```
Raw URL:
```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liegroup-dartmouth/working-aea-jep/refs/heads/gh-pages/papers/v40n1/starr/paper.md
```
Use the article index (above) to get the correct raw URL for any paper rather than constructing paths manually.

## Navigation

- [ai-access.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liegroup-dartmouth/working-aea-jep/refs/heads/gh-pages/ai-access.md): access guidance for agents.
- [view-articles.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liegroup-dartmouth/working-aea-jep/refs/heads/gh-pages/view-articles.md): human-facing tabular catalog.
- [download-articles.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liegroup-dartmouth/working-aea-jep/refs/heads/gh-pages/download-articles.md): instructions for downloading papers and viewing them locally.

## Optional

- [sitemap.xml](https://liegroup-dartmouth.github.io/working-aea-jep/sitemap.xml): full list of canonical public URLs.
